name: Excel-like Supabase table editor browser plugin

mentions.name: Excel-like Supabase table editor browser plugin
mentions.description: A browser plugin that lets you edit Supabase database tables in an Excel-like spreadsheet interface while working on a branch, with tables becoming read-only after switching to the main branch.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a browser plugin that lets you edit Supabase database tables just like Excel, until it's ready. Then you switch to the main branch and the tables will be read only
